notes.1.6: Line 7: the grammar of rḏ.yt nqm Snyj is uncertain, and so is whether Seni is the sufferer or a third servant; zhꜣi̯, 'confound', is uncertain.

nodes.text: Now let a healthy male child be born to me, for you are an excellent akh-spirit.
Look now, these two maidservants who have caused Seni to suffer, Nefertjentet and Itjai: confound(?) them!
Remove for [me] every affliction that is against [my] wife, for you know that [I] am indeed in need of it.
